manuscript_positioning_statement: This work introduces a structural vibrational mapping framework and reports preliminary correspondences between octave-normalized protein eigenmodes and frequency values derived from prior physiological frequency classification systems. The existence, magnitude, and biological significance of these associations remain hypotheses requiring independent validation.

prior_art.scope: Transforming sound recordings into frequency-domain representations, identifying zero-slope signatures and frequency ranges across octaves, and comparing frequency patterns with physiological profiles.

present_contribution.author: Alan Phipps
present_contribution.scope: Deriving collective vibrational eigenmode signatures directly from experimentally resolved 3D biomolecular structures (.cif) via Gaussian Network Models (GNM) and Kirchhoff Contact Laplacian spectral graph theory, plus Attributed Temporal Fact Hypergraph (HomeTree ATFH) cross-linking.

intellectual_lineage_and_attribution.synthesis_equation: Dean Physiological Frequency Profiling + Protein Structural Biology + Gaussian Network Models + Spectral Graph Theory = Structural Vibrational Frequency Mapping
